businessRules: storage never gets a published port or Traefik exposure beyond its one router; only relay and the browser's device calls reach it, everything else is internal-network only
migrations run via `docker compose run --rm migrate` before the first `up` against a new database, using the direct (:5432) connection string
architecturalRules: npm ci is scoped by --workspace rather than --omit=optional, since --omit=optional also drops @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu (an optional dependency on the same platform-binary mechanism as the Claude SDK's native binary) and breaks vite build
the relay's Traefik router carries no StripPrefix middleware - relay/src/index.ts matches url.pathname exactly, so a rewritten path closes the socket with 1008

storage's public router excludes /v1/devices/verify by rule, on top of that route's own shared-secret gate - defense in depth: a network-level exclusion and an application-level check, either could fail without the other
the storage image installs openssl explicitly - node:22-slim ships without libssl and Prisma's query engine otherwise falls back to a guessed build and warns at every boot

features.name: Hosted device gate
features.purpose: Gates the hosted web app behind 'which of my machines am I talking to': lists paired machines, pairs new ones, switches between them, and re-gates if the active machine is revoked or the socket closes with an auth-shaped code. Inert in a local build.
businessRules: pairing a new machine only becomes the active one automatically if none was active before - silently moving a working session to a different computer would be worse than an extra click
revoking is described in the UI as what it does: stops a machine reconnecting, does not sever a connection already open
the Machines settings section does not render in a local build - a one-row list of the machine you're already on is noise
architecturalRules: Clerk token providers are installed during render, not inside useEffect - child effects (DeviceGate) run before parent effects (AuthedConnect), so an effect-based registration meant the device list's first fetch and the first socket connect both fired with no token attached
switchDevice closes the existing socket and clears bootstrapped before reconnecting, rather than waiting for the old one to drop - in-flight messages on it belong to the old machine's bridge
the socket URL is built with URL/searchParams, not concatenation - the relay matches its endpoint path exactly and a concatenated token could produce a non-matching path

features.name: Tool call structured input
features.purpose: Replace the raw JSON dump every transcript tool card showed (collapsed one-liner and expanded body) with a per-tool structured field list; raw JSON stays one toggle away. A resolved edit or answered AskUserQuestion drops its now-redundant expand affordance / duplicate summary card.
businessRules: every tool's expanded body shows a structured field list, never raw JSON by default; raw JSON is one toggle away for every tool with no exceptions

a tool call already fully explained elsewhere in the row loses its expand affordance instead of showing an empty/redundant body: a successful edit (diff button covers it) and a resolved AskUserQuestion (its own card carries the review) are the current cases
an AskUserQuestion call's answer is read from its tool result's prose, not its input — the input only ever contains the questions asked
architecturalRules: toolFields degrades instead of failing: an unclassifiable value becomes a capped json field rather than throwing or being skipped, since tool input shapes (especially MCP tools) are not controlled by this code
OptionCard gained a readOnly prop instead of being duplicated into a second component, so a settled answer looks exactly like the choice that produced it
the raw-input toggle shows even for an empty ({}) input, unlike PermissionPrompt's equivalent guard — consistency across every tool card was chosen over hiding a no-op toggle
